top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. The operation did not know who they were responsible to pick up  on the day of the incident. As a result, the operation failed to pick up two children from elementary school.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions (26 TAC §746.3805(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A medication safe for the use of children ages 4yo and up was administered to a child age 3yo.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when parent was advised medication will not be administered unless amendment  in writing by the child s health-care professional is provided.

top_violation_types.title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §746.305(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not report unsafe conditions in a timely manner.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.
